assets.title: Hallway approaching washroom
assets.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Correct image 5 for AIKO's house story, portrait 1:2, using the SAME room as reference 1.
Reference 1 is the master floorplan view FROM THE BATH. Its visible doorway on the LEFT wall leads to the hallway. Reference 2 is the sink detail. Reference 3 is the hallway exterior framing only, with incorrect contents beyond its door.
Create the new camera view standing in the HALLWAY just outside the LEFT-WALL DOORWAY shown in reference 1, facing through that opening across the washroom toward the sink. This requires rotating the camera approximately 90 degrees relative to reference 1, NOT shrinking reference 1 and placing it through a doorway.
Physical room plan: the sink/wood mirror/white washing machine occupy the wall OPPOSITE the hallway entrance. The frosted window, towel rack, hamper occupy the wall to the viewer's LEFT when entering. The opening to the bath is on the viewer's RIGHT. Keep the actual fixtures fixed in the room. The sink and mirror should appear almost frontally across the room with a gentle oblique angle, not receding along the right wall into the distance. The actual frosted window must be on the left side wall, NOT directly ahead above or left beside the sink on the far wall. A mirror reflection must not be mistaken for a second actual window.
Hallway foreground has honey oak floor, wooden doorway, partial kitchen opening left and hallway plant cabinet right as reference 3. Widen framing enough to see the layout naturally. Beyond threshold cream tile, sage striped mat across the sink, white rectangular ceramic basin on honey oak two-door vanity, chrome faucet, white potted plant at sink left, white pump then sage pump then green toothbrush cup at right matching reference 2. Wooden framed mirror above sink, white washing machine to its right. On left wall actual frosted window and beneath/near it wicker hamper and narrow towel shelf, preserving reference1's arrangement as seen from this changed viewpoint. A narrow glimpse of bath doorway on right is enough.
Preserve AIKO hand painted anime storybook rendering and warm morning light, cream honey-wood and sage palette. No people or reflections of people, no text, no UI. The priority is physically consistent room geometry viewed through the existing LEFT entrance, rather than repeating the bath viewpoint.

No bathtub or shower visible on the left. The bathing compartment is behind the viewer/camera.
Preserve the sink on the RIGHT in its existing slight three-quarter angle and orientation, NOT frontal and NOT mirrored. Preserve the same white rectangular basin, chrome tap, oak two-door cabinet with silver handles, wood-framed wide MIRROR above it, white-potted plant at counter LEFT, white and sage pump bottles and sage cup of toothbrushes at counter RIGHT, sage side towel and washing machine partly at far right. Keep rear frosted window, towel shelf and folded green towels, wicker hamper, cream tiled floor, sage striped rug, warm morning light and softly painted AIKO storybook style. The mirror remains a mirror, not an exterior window. No people/reflections, bodies, typography, labels, UI or watermark.
The reader should immediately understand: camera is at the bath side; household entrance is LEFT; familiar angled vanity is RIGHT.
